follow-up time: Variable, up to 2 years (June 1, 2019 to June 30, 2021)
exposure: Mode of delivery (Cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 375 neonates admitted to the NICU of selected public hospitals in the Gurage zone, Ethiopia, from June 1, 2019 to June 30, 2021
finding: Perinatal asphyxia, cesarean section delivery, maternal age greater than or equal to 35 years, and twin pregnancy were significant predictors of neonatal mortality in this Ethiopian cohort.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with an increased risk of neonatal mortality.
